instances.why: Cites one work and relates it to nothing else.

instances.why: Cites one work and relates it to nothing else.

instances.text: LamRA [cite] leverages large multimodal models as retrieval assistants through instruction tuning.
instances.why: Cites one work and relates it to nothing else.

instances.text: Critically, Skean et al. [cite] showed that intermediate layers of language models often encode richer representations than final layers, a finding that motivates our use of cross-layer signals for routing decisions.

instances.why: Cites one work and relates it to nothing else.
